actions.title: Prepare a runnable attempt
actions.instruction: From clean main, run the installed Preview 0.30 Academy Prepare command for your operating system.
actions.rationale: The prepared commit must bind the original board line and contract sentence before learner work begins.
actions.expected_result: Academy creates a clean numbered F03 attempt with academy.docs.0001 queued and docs/ticket-list-contract.md seeded.
actions.recovery: If Prepare reports a missing prerequisite, complete F02 before returning to clean main and trying again. If it reports an existing attempt or dirty checkout, return to clean main or use Reset before trying again.
actions.evidence: The prepared commit establishes the comparison base.

actions.title: Read the bounded docs task
actions.instruction: On the prepared attempt, read academy.docs.0001 and its continuation lines before changing anything. Its boundary is docs/ticket-list-contract.md, and the task must remain in progress.
actions.rationale: The exact task text defines the work file, evidence, and prohibition on completing the task in this lesson.
actions.expected_result: The prepared board shows academy.docs.0001 as [ ] and names docs/ticket-list-contract.md as its sole work boundary.
actions.recovery: If the task is absent, already started, completed, or points elsewhere, stop. Do not substitute another task or edit the board by hand.
actions.evidence: The prepared task line and continuation fields identify this exercise boundary.

actions.title: Start the docs task through CodeArbiter
actions.instruction: In the prepared attempt, use the host-native task command to start academy.docs.0001. This is an agent command, not a shell command.
actions.rationale: The task writer owns the canonical [~] transition and started date.
actions.expected_result: The task writer changes academy.docs.0001 from [ ] to [~], adds the real started date, and leaves its text unchanged.
actions.recovery: If the command blocks, preserve its message and stop. Do not imitate the transition with a direct board edit.
actions.evidence: The durable board state can later be inspected, but it cannot authenticate which agent command produced it.

actions.title: Inspect the in-progress transition
actions.instruction: Inspect the task writer's diff before starting the docs chore. Confirm that only academy.docs.0001 moved to [~] with a started date.
actions.rationale: The board transition must ride the work commit, so it remains unstaged and uncommitted at this point.
actions.expected_result: The board diff contains one queued-to-started line change for academy.docs.0001, and no commit exists after Prepare yet.
actions.recovery: If another task or continuation line changed, stop before the docs lane. Preserve the diff for diagnosis.
actions.evidence: The reviewed unstaged diff shows the candidate board half of the co-commit.

actions.title: Read the exact contract correction
actions.instruction: Read docs/ticket-list-contract.md. The bounded correction replaces its false sentence with: Ticket list output shows the claimant for a claimed ticket and no claimant for an open ticket.
actions.rationale: The docs chore needs one exact factual correction, not a broad rewrite or implementation change.
actions.expected_result: You can state the one replacement sentence and the rule it records: claimed tickets show a claimant; open tickets do not.
actions.recovery: If the prepared sentence already differs, stop. Do not adapt the correction to a different document version.
actions.evidence: The prepared document supplies the original byte boundary for Check.

actions.title: Run the real docs chore
actions.instruction: Invoke the host-native docs chore. When the host asks for scope, supply only the approved claimant-visibility correction in docs/ticket-list-contract.md. Keep academy.docs.0001 at [~].
actions.rationale: The docs lane applies its normal review, anti-slop, commit-gate, and branch-completion workflow to the bounded correction.

variants.command: /ca:chore docs Correct claimant visibility in docs/ticket-list-contract.md
$ca-chore docs Correct claimant visibility in docs/ticket-list-contract.md
/ca-chore docs Correct claimant visibility in docs/ticket-list-contract.md
/skill:ca-chore docs Correct claimant visibility in docs/ticket-list-contract.md

actions.expected_result: The host changes only the contract sentence, preserves the in-progress board transition, and pauses for review before its normal commit gate.
actions.recovery: If the host proposes code, task completion, another document, or release metadata, stop the chore and preserve the current diff.
actions.evidence: The later commit can prove the resulting repository boundary, not that this agent command ran.

actions.title: Review the staged co-commit
actions.instruction: When the docs chore pauses before commit, run both native-terminal inspections for your operating system: the staged path list and the full staged diff. Authorize its commit gate only after both prove that exactly .codearbiter/open-tasks.md and docs/ticket-list-contract.md are staged, academy.docs.0001 remains [~], and the document contains only the approved sentence replacement.
actions.rationale: Starting the task and doing its bounded work belong in one commit. A board-only commit or a document-only commit breaks that rule.
actions.expected_result: Both inspections prove that the staged path set is exactly .codearbiter/open-tasks.md and docs/ticket-list-contract.md. The full staged diff shows the [~] board transition plus only the approved sentence replacement, ready for one commit.
actions.recovery: If either inspection shows a missing or extra path, a different diff, or academy.docs.0001 as [x], do not authorize the commit gate. Keep the staged state visible for correction, then run both inspections again before authorizing.
actions.evidence: The learner reviews the exact staged co-commit before authorizing the docs lane to continue.

actions.title: Keep the attempt branch local
actions.instruction: After the docs chore's normal commit gate succeeds and its branch-completion handoff appears, choose Keep the branch as-is (I'll handle it later).
actions.rationale: The Academy attempt needs its local evidence branch intact and does not need remote publication.
actions.expected_result: The numbered attempt stays checked out and clean with one local co-commit, no push, and no hosted pull request.
actions.recovery: Do not choose merge, push, pull request, or discard. If another option already ran, stop and preserve the resulting state.
actions.evidence: The local branch and commit remain available; no hosted pull request is created or claimed.

actions.title: Confirm the one-commit result
actions.instruction: Inspect status, the latest commit, and its changed paths after choosing Keep the branch as-is.
actions.rationale: Check requires one post-Prepare commit, the exact two-path co-commit, and no non-ignored worktree state.

variants.command:
git status --short
git log --oneline --decorate -1
git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD

git status --short
git log --oneline --decorate -1
git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD

git status --short
git log --oneline --decorate -1
git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD

actions.expected_result: Status is empty, and the only post-Prepare commit changes .codearbiter/open-tasks.md and docs/ticket-list-contract.md.
actions.recovery: If status is not clean or history has another learner commit, preserve the branch. Do not amend, squash, reset, or delete evidence.
actions.evidence: The one post-Prepare commit and no non-ignored worktree state form the durable local result.

actions.title: Check the durable co-commit
actions.instruction: From the retained attempt branch, run the installed Preview 0.30 Academy Check command for your operating system.
actions.rationale: Repository evidence can validate content and history without claiming agent telemetry.
actions.expected_result: Check accepts only the exact one-commit, two-path, clean result with academy.docs.0001 still [~].
actions.recovery: Read the named durable-state mismatch, repair only that mismatch, and run Check again.
actions.evidence: Check can inspect board bytes, document bytes, commit topology, commit date, changed paths, and worktree cleanliness. It cannot prove `$ca-task` ran and cannot prove `$ca-chore` ran.

actions.title: Reset for a fresh retry
actions.instruction: From the clean retained F03 attempt branch, not main, run the installed Preview 0.30 Academy Reset command for your operating system when you need a fresh F03 attempt.
actions.rationale: A new attempt must preserve failed evidence instead of rewriting the one-commit history.
actions.expected_result: Reset archives the failed prepared attempt before a new numbered attempt is created.
actions.recovery: Keep work you need intact; do not force-reset, rebase, or delete the branch to imitate Academy attempt bookkeeping.
actions.evidence: Reset preserves failed evidence before a new attempt begins.

actions.title: Return safely to main for F04
actions.instruction: After F03 Check passes and you do not need Reset, return to main before beginning F04. Keep the completed F03 attempt branch intact.
actions.rationale: F04 Prepare requires the Academy base branch, while the retained F03 branch remains the durable local evidence.
actions.expected_result: main is checked out with an empty status, and the completed numbered F03 attempt branch still exists locally.
actions.recovery: If status is not empty, do not force-switch, reset, rebase, delete, or hide the attempt. Preserve it and resolve the reported state before continuing.
actions.evidence: The terminal shows main and no worktree changes; the retained F03 branch remains available for its Check evidence.
